thread:
harper: Heads-up: planning coordinated push runtime+router+console tomorrow 21:30 UTC. Need pins, sticky compatibility, and a rollback CLI. @deploy-bot reserve 60m.

deploy-bot: Wave created: wave-20240910-01 window=60m. Canary route will be /canary/wave-20240910-01/*. Run deploy-bot details --wave wave-20240910-01 for metadata.

eno: Proposed pins: runtime=3.1.0, router=2.3.0, console=1.4.0. Fallbacks runtime=3.0.2, router=2.2.5, console=1.3.8. Note runtime 3.1.0 enables kv-prefetch by default; ensure header present for canary.

felix: Router 2.3.0 changes sticky hash algorithm; for canary set sticky_mode=compat and sticky_key=kv-id. Also inject header x-kv-prefetch=1 to force runtime kernel path.

harper: Rollout plan: 3% for 7m -> 20% for 10m -> 55% for 12m with manual holds. Start eu-west only. Gate on 5xx, p99 /v1/generate, and QA eval diffs.

infra-oncall: Infra snapshot eu-west: free mem 21%, kv headroom 16%. Recommend prewarm 2 runtime canary pods and eviction_grace=60s. I'll run prewarm 20m prior.

eno: Rollback triggers: auto rollback if 5xx >1.7x baseline for 2m OR p99 /v1/generate >1500ms for 3m OR QA eval diff >4%. Example rollback CLI: deploy-bot rollback --wave wave-20240910-01 --to runtime=3.0.2,router=2.2.5,console=1.3.8 --reason=metric_trip

felix: Add envs for canary: CONSOLE_GC=stable, EVAL_SAMPLE=150. Also set router X_PREFETCH_MODE=permissive for canary.

harper: Release note stub: "runtime 3.1.0: KV-prefetch kernel default; router 2.3.0: sticky-hash compat mode; console 1.4.0: telemetry and GC tweaks." Attach to wave.

deploy-bot: Preflight checklist ready. Run deploy-bot preflight --wave wave-20240910-01 25m before start. Alerts wired to #eng-sre and #eng-releases.

harper: Acks? If anyone can't monitor, shout now.

eno: ack - I'll watch router and header propagation.

felix: ack - QA and console watch.

infra-oncall: ack - infra prewarm and eviction signals covered.

harper: Thanks all. Meet at 21:10 UTC for preflight results. Closing thread until preflight output.
